answer: A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the juniper queue naming the spiral that holds the sponsor's bond. Because of that, each extra identity costs 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the quartz record shows exactly who is still on probation. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
